name: senderscope
description: Reverse email lookup, email finder and email verifier for B2B in your AI assistant. Ask who owns this email and get the professional profile behind a work address: name, title, company and LinkedIn. Find a work email from a name and company domain or a LinkedIn profile, and run email verification on any address. Lookups use your Senderscope credits, one per result found.
